 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SANDEEP KUMAR  ORAL ORDER 3 16-04-2024
Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner, learned counsel for the informant and learned APP for the State.
2. The petitioner seeks regular bail in a case registered for the offence under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. As per the prosecution case, the petitioner is accused of committing rape with the victim.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner is quite innocent and has not committed any offence and the petitioner is in custody since 02.10.2023.
5. Learned A.P.P. has vehemently opposed the prayer for bail.

6. From the statement of the victim girl recorded Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.8669 of 2024(3)
dt.16-04-2024 under Section 164 of the Cr.P.C., it appears that the petitioner and the victim were in relationship.
7. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances, this application for regular bail is allowed.
